metadata.source: Star Citizen HTML binding files (sc-bindings directory)
metadata.description: Comprehensive extraction of ALL Star Citizen commands from official HTML documentation
metadata.extractionMethod: Manual data extraction and parsing from HTML files
metadata.coverage: Complete coverage of major command categories including Flight, Ground Vehicle, On-foot/EVA, Mining, Targeting, Camera, MFDs, Social, and Turrets

Camera.description: Camera controls and functions including spectator mode and advanced camera controls

Camera - Advanced Camera Controls.name: Advanced Camera Controls Modifier (Hold)
Camera - Advanced Camera Controls.description: Mine allows me to control the camera with one hand

Camera - Advanced Camera Controls.name: Advanced Camera Controls Modifier (Hold)
Camera - Advanced Camera Controls.description: This doesn't seem to do the same as the above

Camera - Advanced Camera Controls.name: Y Offset Positive / Spectator Freecam Focal Point Forward
Y Offset Negative / Spectator Freecam Focal Point Backward

Ground Vehicle - Movement.name: Pitch Up / Down (Mouse)
Ground Vehicle - Movement.description: This is the axis it takes for me to control the Rover mining arm

Industry & Mining.description: Mining and salvage operations for vehicles and ships

Vehicles - Salvage.description: Mine will conflict with default Next Operator Mode

On Foot & EVA.description: On-foot movement, combat, and EVA (Extra-Vehicular Activity) controls

On Foot - All.description: Right shoulder first, and cycles through shoulder weapons

On Foot - All.name: Select Secondary Weapon
On Foot - All.description: Left shoulder first, and cycles through shoulder weapons

On Foot - All.description: This pulls whatever is on your right leg only

On Foot - All.name: Select Gadget
On Foot - All.description: This pulls whatever is equiped to your left leg
